'''Lord Maxwell Tyrosus''' is a [[human]] [[quest giver]] and is the leader of the [[Argent Dawn]]. He resides in [[Light's Hope Chapel]] in the [[Eastern Plaguelands]], and rarely sees visitors from outside his organization. From there he coordinates the troops of the Argent Dawn to fight the [[Scourge]] in the Eastern Plaguelands and is planning with [[Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff]] an offensive on [[Stratholme]] to eliminate [[Baron Rivendare]].
